title: Can AI Replace Developers? I Built an App With ZERO Coding

lines: This app tracks every rupee I earn from my side hustles.
I didn't write a single line of code.
I didn't hire a developer.
I just asked AI to build it.
Let me show you exactly how.
Building an app can cost anywhere from fifty thousand to five lakh rupees, sometimes more.
So today's question is simple.
Can AI really replace developers?
I'll show you every prompt, and every step.
And at the end, three ways you can actually make money with this skill.
Step one: plan the app.
I don't know what features an app needs, so I asked AI.
Here's exactly what I typed.
In seconds, it planned everything.
A form to add income.
A big total for the month.
A list of every entry.
And a chart showing which hustle earns the most.
That's basically a planning meeting, done for free.
Step two: build it.
I gave AI one detailed prompt, in plain English.
The app's name, what it should do, dark mode, a green colour, and that it must save my data.
Then AI started writing the code.
Every line you see here was written by AI.
Around two hundred and thirty lines of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
I didn't touch any of it.
And here's the result.
Let me add some income.
Twenty-five hundred rupees from freelancing, for a logo design.
Twelve hundred from YouTube.
And eight hundred from selling an Etsy template.
Look at that. The total updates instantly.
The chart shows which hustle is winning.
And if I close the app, and open it again...
everything is still saved.
Step three: changes.
When you want something changed, you don't write code.
You just describe it.
For example: add a way to delete an entry if I make a mistake.
Done.
But here's the honest part.
This app saves data only on this phone.
There's no login, and no cloud backup.
If I clear my browser data, it's gone.
For a personal tracker, that's fine. For a real business, you'd need a lot more.
Step four: put it online.
Because this app is just one file, you can host it for free, on services like GitHub Pages, Netlify, or Vercel.
Upload the file, and you get a link that opens on any phone.
Just check each service's current free plan before you rely on it.
So, did AI just replace developers?
Honestly? No. Not completely.
AI is amazing for simple apps, tools, prototypes, and small business websites.
Things that used to take weeks can now take an afternoon.
But for apps with millions of users, payments, security, or private data, you still need real developers who understand what the code is doing.
AI didn't replace developers.
It replaced the excuse that you need to be a developer to build something.
And that's an opportunity.
Here are three ways to make money with this.
One. Build simple apps for local businesses: booking forms, digital menus, and order trackers.
Many small shops can't afford a big agency, but they may pay a few thousand rupees for something simple that works.
Two. Sell small tools and templates online, like budget trackers or habit trackers.
Three. Offer AI app building as a freelance service.
My advice: build your first app for free, for a friend's shop.
Use it as your portfolio, then charge for the next one.
There are no guarantees, but the skill is real.
In my next video, I'll try to sell an AI-built app to a real local business, and show you whether anyone actually pays.
Subscribe so you don't miss it.
And comment below: what app should AI build next?
